questions.question: Anita bought a square plot to build a house for his family. Each dimension of the plot is in whole numbers of yards. Which of the following can be an area (in square yards) of the plot?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The area of a **square plot** is always a **perfect square** if the side is a **whole number**.

Area = (Side)²

Check the options for a **perfect square**: 29 × 29 = 841.

Since 841 is the only **perfect square** among the options, it must be the area.

**∴ The correct answer is 841 square yards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Each dimension (side) of the **square plot** is a **whole number**.

**Formula Used:** Area of a square = (Side)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01ffb04722970120d12f7cd75351194eb2e462b23a39fd77a62607a3863ad029.png] 

⇒ Let the side of the **square plot** be s yards.

⇒ Area = s² square yards.

⇒ Since s is a **whole number**, the area must be a **perfect square**.

⇒ √861 ≈ 29.34 (Not a whole number)

⇒ √841 = 29 (A **whole number**)

⇒ √881 ≈ 29.68 (Not a whole number)

⇒ √891 ≈ 29.84 (Not a whole number)

⇒ Since 841 is the square of 29, it is the only possible area.

**∴ The correct answer is 841 square yards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Perfect Squares

A **perfect square** never ends in the digits 2, 3, 7, or 8. It must end in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9.

Area and Perimeter of Square

The area is given by s² and the **perimeter** is 4 × s, where s is the side length.

Diagonal of a Square

The **diagonal** of a square with side s is s√2. Also, Area = (Diagonal²) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: A building has a regular decagon-shaped window. What is the internal angle between any two adjacent sides?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon** with **n** sides, the exterior angle is calculated as 360° ÷ n.

For a **regular decagon**, n = 10.

Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ 10 = 36°.

Internal Angle = 180° − Exterior Angle = 180° − 36° = 144°.

**∴ The correct answer is 144°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The window is in the shape of a **regular decagon**.

Number of sides (n) = 10.

**Formula Used:**

The **sum of internal angles** of a polygon with n sides = (n − 2) × 180°.

Each **internal angle** of a regular polygon = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ea240aa0b81ac9b83f480ecb9e2033c40a8e4bf1995e32a5d97ef863a823a2c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of sides (n) = 10

⇒ Sum of all internal angles = (10 − 2) × 180°

⇒ Sum = 8 × 180° = 1440°

⇒ Value of each internal angle = 1440° ÷ 10

⇒ Internal angle = 144°

**∴ The correct answer is 144°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

For any convex polygon, the sum of all exterior angles is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Interior and Exterior Angle Relation

At any vertex of a polygon, the sum of the interior angle and the exterior angle is exactly 180° (Linear Pair).

Common Polygon Angles

Regular Pentagon (n=5): 108° | Regular Hexagon (n=6): 120° | Regular Octagon (n=8): 135°.</p

questions.question: A pharmaceutical capsule is shaped like a right circular cylinder of radius 0.4 cm and height 1.5 cm . Find the total surface area assuming flat ends.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

r = 0.4 cm

h = 1.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × (r + h)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 3.14 × 0.4 × (0.4 + 1.5)

⇒ = 2 × 3.14 × 0.4 × 1.9

⇒ = 2 × 3.14 × 0.76

⇒ = 2 × 2.3864

⇒ = 4.77 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4.77 cm².**

questions.question: A sculptor wants to cast wax models in the shape of right triangular prisms. Each prism has a triangular base with sides measuring 9 cm, 10 cm, and 17 cm, and the height (length of prism) is 25 cm. If he plans to make 20 such wax models, what is the total volume of wax required?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of triangle = 9, 10, 17

Height of prism = 25

Number of prisms = 20

**Formula Used:**

Area of triangle (Heron) = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Volume = Base area × height

**Calculation:**

⇒ s = (9 + 10 + 17) ÷ 2 = 18

⇒ Area = √[18 × 9 × 8 × 1]

⇒ Area = √1296 = 36

⇒ Volume of one prism = 36 × 25 = 900

⇒ Total volume = 900 × 20 = 18000

**∴ The correct answer is 18000 cm³.**

questions.question: If x = 6cos A + 8sin A and y = 6sin A - 8cos A, find the value of x2 + y2.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x = 6cosA + 8sinA

y = 6sinA − 8cosA

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

sin²A + cos²A = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ x² = (6cosA + 8sinA)² = 36cos²A + 64sin²A + 96sinAcosA

⇒ y² = (6sinA − 8cosA)² = 36sin²A + 64cos²A − 96sinAcosA

⇒ x² + y² = 36(cos²A + sin²A) + 64(sin²A + cos²A)

⇒ x² + y² = 36 × 1 + 64 × 1

⇒ x² + y² = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

questions.question: A, B, and C invested in a business in the ratio of 5 : 3 : 2. After 6 months, A doubled his investment, B increased his investment by 50%, and C kept his investment the same. If the total profit at the end of 1 year is Rs.90,000, how much will B receive?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Investment ratio = 5 : 3 : 2

Total time = 12

Change after = 6

Total profit = 90000

**Formula Used:**

Profit ∝ Investment × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ A investment = 5

⇒ First 6 months = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ Next 6 months = 10 × 6 = 60

⇒ Total A = 30 + 60 = 90

⇒ B investment = 3

⇒ First 6 months = 3 × 6 = 18

⇒ Next 6 months = 4.5 × 6 = 27

⇒ Total B = 18 + 27 = 45

⇒ C investment = 2

⇒ First 6 months = 2 × 6 = 12

⇒ Next 6 months = 2 × 6 = 12

⇒ Total C = 12 + 12 = 24

⇒ Ratio = 90 : 45 : 24

⇒ Ratio = 30 : 15 : 8

⇒ Total parts = 30 + 15 + 8 = 53

⇒ B share = 90000 × 15 ÷ 53

⇒ B share ≈ 25471.7

**∴ The correct answer is 25472.**

questions.question: If sin(2x) = cos(x + 30°), what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the trigonometric identity **sin A = cos B** to be true, the angles must be **complementary**.

Therefore, **A + B = 90°**.

Substituting the given values: **2x + (x + 30°) = 90°**.

3x + 30° = 90° ⇒ 3x = 60° ⇒ x = **20°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 20°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin(2x) = cos(x + 30°)

**Formula Used:** sin θ = cos(90° − θ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae1950824f142885c3c6f0b0598d85036f5b980ea28c65dd3e89f32d6d3f7a57.png] 

Applying the transformation to the **Left Hand Side (LHS)**:

⇒ cos(90° − 2x) = cos(x + 30°)

By comparing the **angles** on both sides:

⇒ 90° − 2x = x + 30°

⇒ 90° − 30° = x + 2x

⇒ 60° = 3x

⇒ x = 60° ÷ 3

⇒ x = 20°

**∴ The correct answer is 20°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Complementary Angles

Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90°. Standard relations include: **sin θ = cos(90° − θ)**, **tan θ = cot(90° − θ)**, and **sec θ = cosec(90° − θ)**.

Reciprocal Identities

Standard reciprocal relations: **cosec θ = 1 ÷ sin θ**, **sec θ = 1 ÷ cos θ**, and **cot θ = 1 ÷ tan θ**.

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental relations between functions: **sin²θ + cos²θ = 1** and **1 + tan²θ = sec²θ**.</p

questions.question: If A, B and C are three numbers, such that the L.C.M. of A and B is B and the L.C.M. of B and C is C, then the L.C.M. of A, B and C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

LCM(A, B) = B

LCM(B, C) = C

**Formula Used:**

If LCM(a, b) = b then a divides b

LCM of multiple numbers is the greatest among them if each divides the next

**Calculation:**

⇒ From LCM(A, B) = B ⇒ A divides B

⇒ From LCM(B, C) = C ⇒ B divides C

⇒ Therefore A divides B and B divides C ⇒ A divides C

⇒ So C is the largest multiple covering A and B

⇒ LCM(A, B, C) = C

**∴ The correct answer is C.**

questions.question: Income of A is 20 percent more than income of B and the income of B is 25 percent more than income of C. A's income is how much percentage more than C's income?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 20% more than B

B = 25% more than C

**Formula Used:**

If X is a% more than Y ⇒ X = Y × (1 + a ÷ 100)

Percentage increase = (Difference ÷ Original) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let C = 100

⇒ B = 100 × (1 + 25 ÷ 100) = 100 × 1.25 = 125

⇒ A = 125 × (1 + 20 ÷ 100) = 125 × 1.20 = 150

⇒ Increase from C to A = 150 - 100 = 50

⇒ Percentage increase = 50 ÷ 100 × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

questions.question: If sqrt{a}+sqrt{b}=10 and sqrt{a}-sqrt{b}=4, then what is the value of a + b?

questions.question: In how much time will a sum of Rs. 12000 amounts to Rs. 15600 at the rate of 5 percent per annum at simple interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Interest** for 1 year = 5% of ₹12000 = ₹600

Total **Simple Interest (SI)** required = ₹15600 − ₹12000 = ₹3600

**Time** = Total Interest ÷ Interest per year

⇒ Time = 3600 ÷ 600 = 6 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹12000

**Amount (A)** = ₹15600

**Rate (R)** = 5% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A − P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b82fb8b061a967f49dd9d3eaa4075c71973552c7e971de509a6f76a9be0f1989.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = 15600 − 12000 = ₹3600

⇒ 3600 = (12000 × 5 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 3600 = 120 × 5 × T

⇒ 3600 = 600 × T

⇒ T = 3600 ÷ 600

⇒ T = 6 years

**∴ The correct answer is 6 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Amount Formula

The total amount in simple interest can be directly calculated using A = P(1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest remains constant every year, whereas Compound Interest increases as interest is calculated on the previous year's interest.

Effective Rate of Interest

The total interest percentage over 'T' years at 'R' rate is simply (R × T)%. In this case, 5% × 6 = 30%.

questions.question: Selling price of an article is 140 percent of the value of discount. Marked price is what percent of the value of discount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = 140% of the value of discount

Marked price (MP) = ?% of the value of discount

**Formula Used:**

SP = 140% of discount = (140 ÷ 100) × Discount

MP = SP + Discount

MP = ?% of Discount

**Calculation:**

Let the value of Discount = D.

⇒ SP = (140 ÷ 100) × D = 1.4D

⇒ MP = SP + Discount = 1.4D + D = 2.4D

⇒ MP = 240% of Discount

**∴ The correct answer is 240 percent.**
